name: The Prodigal Lich

narrative.details:
Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge.  You, adventurer, will be that agent.

Present these orders to Bethor.  He will then instruct you on your mission.  I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich.  And it will be dangerous.

So ready yourself, Champion.  You must not fail.

You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
narrative.objectives: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren. Then yes, your business with me is crucial.

I trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Greetings. Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 8 to 12, 3,330 XP in all.

quests.name: Graverobbers
quests.objectiveText: Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels.

quests.name: The Prodigal Lich
quests.objectiveText: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

quests.name: The Lich's Identity
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Lich's Spellbook to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

quests.name: Return the Book
quests.objectiveText: Return Gunther's Spellbook to him, on the island of Gunther's Retreat.

quests.name: Proving Allegiance
quests.objectiveText: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning. Summon Lillith Nefara and kill her. Return to Gunther on his island.

quests.name: The Prodigal Lich Returns
